name: Apex Solventless | 1g Live Rosin Tier 1 | Blue Zushi
description:
Blue Zushi is the legendary cross of Zkittlez and Kush Mints that has circualted through the hash community for the past half a decade! She is known for a deep tropical candy taste. The blue in her name alludes to the sour blue raspberry flavor that accompanies the tropical Z taste we all love. She grows exteremly resinous nugs that are filled with a very desirable taste profile that all solventless fans will enjoy.

Terp Profile: Blue Raspberry, Lime, Candy
